entities.summary: The European University Cyprus (EUC) is a private university in Nicosia, Cyprus and Frankfurt, Germany, which evolved out of Cyprus College, one of the oldest institutions of higher education in Cyprus. Admission to European University Cyprus is based on applicants' academic records and performance. The institution has a current enrollment of over 12,250 students with international students representing about 70% of the student body. It provides internationally recognized undergraduate, graduate, and doctorate degrees.
